description: Decode a CVSS v3.0/v3.1 vector into its base metrics and recompute its base, temporal and environmental scores. Use it on a vector you hold; cve_lookup already gives the scores of a CVE. v2 and v4 are refused.

vector.description: CVSS:3.0/ or CVSS:3.1/ vector with all eight base metrics; temporal and environmental metrics are optional, e.g. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

name: cvss_calculator

base_severity.description: NONE at 0.0, LOW below 4.0, MEDIUM below 7.0, HIGH below 9.0, else CRITICAL.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

environmental_score.description: 0-10, with the environmental metrics of the vector. A metric it leaves out counts as Not Defined. With none, it usually equals base_score, but CVSS 3.1 can give another value.

metrics.description: The eight base metrics, spelled out.

summary.description: One sentence: version, severity, base score, and AV, AC, PR, UI and Scope.

temporal_score.description: 0-10, with the temporal metrics of the vector. A metric it leaves out counts as Not Defined. With none, it equals base_score.

title: CVSS Calculator
